clue.text: Declines credit for essential car accessory

parts.note: to decline is to dip, so declines gives dips
a tick is informal British for credit, as in buying on tick

explanation.surface: A motorist turns down the offer of finance on a must-have car extra.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On tick' is British slang for on credit.
explanation.definitionFit: The rod used to measure engine oil level is a standard piece of kit in any car.

clue.text: Friend early to catch a train initially

indicators.note: the word for early catches, or encloses, the following letters

parts.note: in time means early enough, not late

indicators.note: initially picks the first letter of train

explanation.surface: Advice to a friend to arrive in good time for the train.
explanation.definitionFit: A close confidant or familiar companion is a friend.

clue.text: Who's disported at posh cities?

indicators.note: disported means frolicked about, so the letters cavort into a new order

explanation.surface: Asks who it is that amused themselves in fashionable cities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disported' rearranges 'at posh cities'; the whole clue then describes a person of the world.
explanation.definitionFit: A worldly, cultured person at home in smart urban society is a cosmopolitan type.

clue.text: Damage among 12 good citizens and true

parts.note: among means in
a jury of twelve, echoing the phrase 'twelve good men and true'

explanation.surface: Harm caused within a panel of jurors.
explanation.walkthrough: The traditional description of a jury is 'twelve good men and true'.
explanation.definitionFit: Harm or hurt done to a person or thing is damage.

clue.text: Moose comes up eating a vegetable

indicators.note: the reversed animal takes the letter a inside it
in a down clue, coming up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: in Europe the moose is called an elk

explanation.surface: A moose emerges munching greens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'comes up' turns ELK into KLE, which then holds A.
explanation.definitionFit: A leafy green cabbage variety is a familiar vegetable.

clue.text: Southern dish spread haphazardly

parts.note: a platter is a large serving dish

explanation.surface: Food from the American South served messily on a plate.
explanation.definitionFit: To splash or scatter something in a messy, irregular way.

clue.text: Performance of rock band on one old musical

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means placed above, so the gig comes before the one

parts.note: a gig is a live show by a band
the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A rock group plays a single old show tune.
explanation.walkthrough: Gigi is the 1958 Lerner and Loewe film musical.
explanation.definitionFit: Gigi is a 1950s musical film about a young Parisienne.

clue.text: Raise crew in Orpington?

indicators.note: the crew word goes inside the bird

parts.note: the Orpington is a breed of chicken, so a hen
an eight is a rowing crew of eight oarsmen

explanation.surface: Asks whether to put up a team in Orpington, a London suburb.
explanation.walkthrough: Orpington looks like the south-east London district, but is also a chicken breed.
explanation.definitionFit: To increase or intensify something is to make it greater.

clue.text: Review smartphone program upgrade

parts.note: an app is a program for a smartphone
to upgrade something is to raise it

explanation.surface: Someone writes a review of the latest update to a phone app.
explanation.definitionFit: To review something is to assess or evaluate it, a close synonym.

clue.text: Prevent compensation taking time

indicators.note: the word for compensation takes in, or holds, the time letter

parts.note: a sop is something given to pacify or compensate

explanation.surface: An insurer blocks a payout because the claim took too long.
explanation.definitionFit: To prevent something is to halt it before it happens, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Celebration of moving conflict between two dynasties

indicators.note: the conflict word is placed between the two dynasty names

parts.note: a house is a royal dynasty (the House of Windsor), and Ming was a Chinese dynasty
war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: A history lesson about fighting between two ruling families.
explanation.walkthrough: 'House' here is a royal line, as in the House of Tudor; Ming ruled China 1368-1644.
explanation.definitionFit: A party thrown on settling into a new home marks the move.

clue.text: Skill in shooting 1000 boats, with crew on another boat

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means sitting above, so the crew word precedes the last boat

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for 1000
arks are boats, as Noah's
to man a vessel is to crew it
a ship is another boat

explanation.surface: A boast about firing on a thousand vessels while serving aboard another.
explanation.definitionFit: Proficiency with a gun, accurate aim, is precisely skill in shooting.

clue.text: Trunk carries tyres primarily — certainly makes contribution to road safety

indicators.note: the trunk word holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: a trunk is a large case

indicators.note: primarily picks the first letter of tyres

parts.note: certainly is an emphatic yes

explanation.surface: A car boot full of tyres is somehow claimed to help safety on the roads.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is a verb phrase standing for 'something that makes a contribution'; read it as 'one that makes contribution to road safety'.
explanation.definitionFit: Reflective studs set into British roads mark lanes at night, aiding safety.

clue.text: Feature of rugby seconds, being supported by clubs with spirit

indicators.note: in a down clue, being supported by puts the seconds letter above the clubs letter

parts.note: C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs
rum is a spirit

explanation.surface: Second helpings at a rugby club bar, washed down with spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: The set piece in which forwards bind together and push for the ball is a rugby fixture.

clue.text: Sort of trout swallowing Black Sea fish

indicators.note: the rearranged trout letters take the black letter inside
a sort of trout is the word recast into a different arrangement

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A kind of trout gulping down a fish from the Black Sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sort of' rearranges TROUT to TUROT, which takes in B. 'Black Sea' reads as a place but splits into Black and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A large European flatfish found in salt water, prized for eating.

clue.text: 'House' might split for this

indicators.note: split says the wanted word lies broken across the two words House and might

explanation.surface: A legislative chamber divides over a vote.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer sits split across 'HouSE MIght'; the whole clue also describes a house divided into two homes.
explanation.definitionFit: A semi-detached home is one of a pair joined by a party wall.

clue.text: Like mule delivered after objections raised

indicators.note: after puts the objections before the delivered word
in a down clue, raised means the word is read upwards

parts.note: buts are objections, as in no ifs or buts
a delivered baby is born

explanation.surface: A mule is born after protests are voiced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'raised' turns BUTS upward to give STUB.
explanation.definitionFit: Mules are proverbially obstinate, so mulish means pig-headed.

clue.text: Survivor of Henry VIII stabbed by English blade

indicators.note: the survivor's name is pierced by the English letter, which goes inside

parts.note: Catherine Parr, his sixth wife, outlived him

explanation.surface: A Tudor queen meets a violent end at the hands of an Englishman with a knife.
explanation.walkthrough: Henry VIII's sixth wife Catherine Parr outlived him.
explanation.definitionFit: A small knife for peeling fruit or vegetables is a kind of blade.

clue.text: Came earlier and took prey

definitions.meaning: to antedate is to come before in time
hunted and killed another animal for food

explanation.walkthrough: One spelling covers two words: pre-dated (dated before) and the verb from predator.
explanation.definitionFit: Both 'existed before' and 'hunted as a predator' are senses of this past-tense verb.

clue.text: Viewed part of play in auditorium

indicators.note: an auditorium is where things are heard, signalling a word as spoken

parts.note: a scene is a division of a play

explanation.surface: A theatregoer watched a section of the drama from the seats.
explanation.definitionFit: Past participle of see: looked at or witnessed.

clue.text: One taking charge in 'Vote for Reagan'?

parts.note: to vote for someone is to elect them
Ronald Reagan, shortened to Ron

explanation.surface: A campaign slogan for Ronald Reagan, the man who would take charge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taking charge' sounds like leadership but means bearing electric charge.
explanation.definitionFit: A subatomic particle carries a negative electric charge.

clue.text: Sophisticated ancient city, source of misery

parts.note: Ur was an ancient Sumerian city in Mesopotamia
a bane is a cause of great distress

explanation.surface: A refined old city that was nevertheless a wretched place.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone polished, suave and courteous in manner is refined.

clue.text: Drunk cuts meal, getting wine

indicators.note: drunk suggests the letters are reeling into a new order

explanation.surface: A drunk guest slices up dinner while getting a glass of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweet fortified dessert type made from muscat grapes.

clue.text: Look at article and feel angry

parts.note: to look at something is to see it
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: Reading a newspaper piece makes someone furious.
explanation.definitionFit: To fume or boil inwardly with rage.

clue.text: Complain about northern girl on stage — an angel?

indicators.note: the complaint word goes around the northern letter

parts.note: to beef is slang for to complain
an actress is a woman performing on stage

explanation.surface: Someone gripes about a girl from the north who is performing in a play.
explanation.walkthrough: An 'angel' in theatre slang is a financial backer of a production.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatrical angel is a patron who funds shows, so a female donor fits.

clue.text: North American provided opposite of 3

definitions.note: the solution to 3 down is a worldly person, whose opposite is an innocent

parts.note: provided means if, on condition that

explanation.surface: An American is the reverse of the cosmopolitan type, on one condition.
explanation.definitionFit: A naive, unworldly innocent is the antithesis of a cultured cosmopolitan.

clue.text: Counts slugs

definitions.meaning: to tot up is to add up or count

explanation.walkthrough: 'slugs' suggests garden pests but means swigs of liquor.
explanation.definitionFit: Adds up figures; and small drinks of whisky or similar.

clue.text: Regular parts in theatre accompanied by piano or other instrument

indicators.note: regular parts are every other letter of theatre

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, meaning soft

explanation.surface: In a theatre, a pianist is joined by another musician.
explanation.walkthrough: Every second letter of 'theatre' gives HAR.
explanation.definitionFit: A stringed instrument plucked with the fingers is another musical instrument.

clue.text: Check outlet design again

parts.note: to rein in is to check or restrain
a vent is an opening that lets air or gas out

explanation.surface: An engineer inspects an outlet and decides to redesign it.
explanation.definitionFit: To recreate or remake something from scratch in a new form.

clue.text: Second display of grief is extensive

parts.note: weeping is crying in sorrow

explanation.surface: A mourner breaks down again, at length.
explanation.definitionFit: Wide-ranging changes or reforms are broad in scope.
